facts.fact: Replit is described on the page as a cloud-based app and agent builder with a built-in IDE, AI assistant, and deployment infrastructure.
facts.quote: Replit is a cloud-based app and agent builder with a built in IDE, AI assistant, and deployment infrastructure.

facts.fact: The page states that AgentMail is a connector integration on Replit, so Replit apps and agents can use it directly.
facts.quote: AgentMail is a “connector” integration on Replit, meaning your Replit apps and agents can use it directly.

facts.fact: To set up the Replit integration, a user finds AgentMail in the Integrations tab of the Replit builder, clicks Connect/Sign in, and pastes in an AgentMail API key from the AgentMail Console.
facts.quote: Find AgentMail and click Connect/Sign in. Then paste in your AgentMail API key from the AgentMail Console.

facts.fact: The page states that Replit uses Mastra, a TypeScript framework for building agents, and generates a set of Mastra tools to interface with the AgentMail API for each new app or agent.
facts.quote: Replit uses Mastra, a TypeScript framework for building agents. Everytime you create a new app/agent Replit will generate a set of Mastra tools

facts.fact: AgentMail describes itself on the page as the email inbox API for AI agents, supporting both sending and receiving for two-way email conversations.
facts.quote: AgentMail is the email inbox API for AI agents. It gives agents their own email inboxes, like Gmail does for humans.

facts.fact: The documentation site provides a documentation index at the root level at /llms.txt, and any page URL with .md appended returns the markdown version of that page.
facts.quote: a documentation index is available at the root level at /llms.txt. Append /llms.txt to any URL for a page-level index, or .md for the markdown version of any page.
